module: Internal editor test extension (FFI pointer leaks with ImGui). It opens a "ffi ptr leak test" window with test widgets (checkbox, sliders, text field, image) and the ImGui demo window. It is disabled in this version: the file runs `do return M end` right after `local M = {}`, so the hooks are never exported.
notes: Disabled: `do return M end` at the top of the file. The code that follows (and the export of M.onEditorGui / M.onEditorInitialized) is never executed.
If it were enabled, onEditorGui would use `image.tex` while `image` is only created in onEditorInitialized (texture /art/dynamicDecals/textures/00_color_palette_test.png).

onEditorGui.desc: Editor hook called every GUI frame: draws the ImGui test window. Not exported while the file is disabled.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called at editor initialization: registers the "ffi ptr leak test" window, its Window menu entry and loads the test texture. Not exported while the file is disabled.
